grades.reason: The test 'a client with the wrong bearer token cannot initialize' sends 'not-the-token' and asserts err.code === 401; with no authProvider, SDK 1.29 throws StreamableHTTPError(response.status) on a 401; and the gate in src/routes/mcp.js compares the whole header against `Bearer ${MCP_TOKEN}`, not just whether it is present. Line 395 is in the get_entity scoping tests, not the auth group.

summary: The local review raised one high-severity claim that the code contradicts, since invalid-token handling is tested explicitly, and it offered nothing else; the suite itself matches the item's spec (401 gate, 13-tool set equality, per-workspace scoping, and a fail-closed check with no MCP user configured).
